 Why ‘Sheriff Country,’ ‘Fire Country’ & ‘Boston Blue’ Aren’t New Tonight
 Kelli Boyle 
 November 20, 2026, 2:29 pm 
 Comments 
 CBS 
 What To Know
 CBS’s Sheriff Country, Fire Country, and Boston Blue are not airing new episodes until December 11.
 Find out what’s airing instead and why the shows are on breaks.
 CBS’s Friday primetime schedule has big changes tonight (Friday, November 20). Neither Sheriff Country , Fire Country , nor  Boston Blue is airing a new episode. In fact, all three shows are currently on a three-week break. Here’s what’s causing the schedule changes.
 Friday-night programming on CBS typically has  Sheriff Country at 8/7c,  Fire Country at 9/8c, and  Boston Blue at 10/9c. On November 20,  Sheriff Country is the only scripted show airing, and it’s a rerun that’s on at 10/9c. Airing instead at 8/7c is College Basketball. The Kentucky vs. Indiana game starts at 8/7c. The  Sheriff Country rerun airing at 10 p.m. ET is the Season 2 premiere.
 The Friday primetime scripted lineup won’t return with new episodes until Friday, December 11, due to the Thanksgiving holiday and more special programming. When the shows return, they will be back for the midseason finales.
 The Soul Train Awards are airing on Friday, November 27, at 8/7c on CBS, followed by a rerun of  Boston Blue at 10/9c. On Friday, December 4, college football takes up the time slots until a new episode of  Comics Unleashed With Byron Allen at 11:35 p.m. ET.
 Here are the storylines for the December 11 episodes of Sheriff Country ,  Fire Country , and  Boston Blue .
 Sheriff Country  Season 2 Episode 7, “Stand Your Ground,” 8/7c

Also, Mae turns to Congressman Phil Verbeck for help with the investigation, and Sean and Jonah are forced to make a difficult choice when a fellow officer is caught in the crossfire.”
